settings.heading: Own an Azouz Coffee.
settings.body:
Bring Azouz Coffee to your neighbourhood.

From coffee supply and equipment to branding, menu development and operational support — we help you open and run an Azouz Coffee location.
settings.image_alt: An Azouz Coffee counter: espresso machine, grinder and a 1 kg coffee bag beside it

settings.heading: What You Open With.
settings.body: Everything the location needs, from the coffee itself to the way it runs day to day.

settings.title: Coffee supply
settings.body: Espresso, Turkish, filter and specialty coffee roasted for the location and delivered on a regular schedule.

settings.title: Equipment
settings.body: Machine, grinder and brewing equipment specified for the volume you expect to serve.

settings.title: Branding
settings.body: The Azouz identity applied to the space, the packaging and the signage.

settings.title: Menu development
settings.body: A drinks menu built around the blends, with recipes and pricing guidance.

settings.title: Barista training
settings.body: Training on the machine, the grind and the recipes so the cup is the same every day.

settings.title: Operational support
settings.body: Help with opening, ordering and the routines that keep the counter running.

settings.title: A Full Azouz Coffee Location
settings.body: Your own shop, opened and fitted as an Azouz Coffee from the counter out.

settings.title: An Azouz Corner in Your Business
settings.body: A coffee counter inside a hotel, restaurant, office or retail space you already run.

settings.heading: Supplied by Our Own Roastery.
settings.body: The coffee you serve is roasted, blended and packed by us, so supply, price and taste stay in one place rather than across three suppliers.
settings.image_alt: Roasted coffee falling into the cooling tray at the Azouz roastery

settings.heading: Let's Talk About Your Location.
settings.body: Tell us where you are and what size of space you have, and we'll come back with what opening an Azouz Coffee there involves.
